Every revision re-derives the complete IACS, classifies every addition/removal/merge/split, reruns Promotion Test and Boundary Inflation checks over the entire revised set, updates every conformance/checker subject to the declared composite carrier relation under SPEC_METHOD STDO-UP-022, and reconciles implementation before promotion or closure. conditions: Promotion to a top-level type is proposed.

grounding.quote:
A Subordinate Payload may be promoted to a top-level type only when at least
one of the following is true:

constraints.statement: Every top-level class, dataclass, TypedDict, enum, or named schema record must justify an architectural boundary. Promotion requires at least one of: authoritative source carriage; public/persisted contract boundary; explicit public outcome variant directly pattern-matched by consumers; reuse across multiple modules without semantic bleed; independent versioning, publication, or admission. Promotion is unlawful when the candidate is only internal detail of a larger carrier, a once-used module field grouping, an open-dict typing shim, a private variation crossing no true interface, or a cosmetic/local-field mirror. A shape needing neither independent authority nor independent reuse nor direct pattern-match semantics remains subordinate and nested/private/local. Promotion bears the proof burden; designers and reviewers should assume subordination until an irreducible boundary is shown.

conditions: Schema work; additionally, a schema or ticket listing a wide family of types must distinguish IACS from Subordinate Payloads.

grounding.quote: Typed closure does not excuse Boundary Inflation.

constraints.statement: Schema work must declare IACS, authoritative types, downstream projections, Subordinate Payloads, and payloads intentionally deferred from promotion. Failure to distinguish IACS from payloads in a wide family is design drift. Boundary Inflation is design debt: promoting payload detail because typing feels hard; making internal records public without a new authoritative boundary; creating many near-identical top-level types where one carrier family suffices; or silently turning one migration ticket into several parallel schema migrations. Typed closure supplies no exception.

design-method completion must not rest on
code comparison alone.

constraints.statement: Required derivation evidence follows constitutional WHAT, reference design, target Ontology and reference-to-Ontology mapping, target design mapping, target module assets, and implementation. Minimum assets name source design surfaces; accepted target Ontology disposing reference entities, functions, lifecycle, authority, effects, and projections; replacing/binding target design surfaces; explicit preserved/reshaped/deferred/delivery-binding dispositions; and required module assets including Ontology-derived IACS and three-view design. Without the derivation chain, design-method completion is not established.

grounding.quote:

constraints.statement: Before promotion or design-method closure, require one accepted Ontology and a complete asset containing classDiagram domain, sequenceDiagram execution, and stateDiagram-v2 lifecycle models. conditions: The design asset describes an active boundary.
exceptions: Governing composition and effect algebra is required where applicable.

grounding.quote: The design asset must cite one accepted Ontology for the active boundary

constraints.statement: Cite one accepted Ontology and include or reference its entity/relationship inventory, invariants/cardinalities, entity-lifecycle completeness matrix, authority matrix, atomic/higher-order function derivation matrix, applicable governing composition/effect algebra, whole-family Prime contraction including every accepted atom's admitted domain and realization-projection mapping, and explicit deferred/excluded/unresolved functionality. Copying rows into a local model without that derivation creates another truth surface.

conditions: A proposed bounded action and accepted material-frame basis are assessed.

grounding.quote:
locus of acceptance separates change from violation; explicit disposition,
not equivalence alone, separates lawful duplication from violation.

constraints.statement: Apply the referenced Contract application with selected STDO basis plus accepted design: method supplies relations/deciding laws and design their concrete values; neither substitutes for the other, and repeating federal method is not reconstruction. Recover every governing relation in the causally closed affected set. Preserves operates within an intact relation; changes alters it and needs accepted re-entry at that relation; duplicates establishes an equivalent path explicitly disposed as constituent, replica, replacement, or deliberately independent realization; violates contradicts a relation, leaves an equivalent path undisposed, or accepts a changed relation only inside the acting frame. Evaluate reconstruction sufficiency separately from action lawfulness. Complete reconstruction satisfies sufficiency even for violates; established missing material relations or indistinguishable required cases falsify it; unexamined support or undecided distinctions are indeterminate. Supported preserves, changes with accepted re-entry, and duplicates with required disposition satisfy lawfulness; demonstrated violates falsifies it. Undecided change/duplication acceptance or disposition remains indeterminate unless violation is already established. Unusable subject/basis and established scope/capability shortfall retain invalid_basis/out_of_frame on the affected predicate. Retain classification, reason, performance, and evidence; unsupported labels prove neither predicate. This is a property of existing Ontology, authority/admission relations, frame, views, and module mapping, not another artifact, all future changes, or reviewer performance. Boundary-sufficiency tests use named cases with independently known relations/decisions while withholding history, commentary, prior-worker memory, and implementation folklore; those cannot supply missing relations.
constraints.uncertainty: Contract application and the complete material-frame contract are not supplied.

conditions: For the active boundary.

exceptions: Malformed input/output, retry, recursion, fan-out/fan-in, nested workflow, and human escalation paths are required where applicable.

Every message binds both a declared carrier transform, graph/C constructor, interpreter action, or effect-handler call and an Ontology function with its admitted authority role. conditions: Cross-view evaluation of the named boundary and governing basis.
exceptions: Only supported applicability results exclude axioms; excluded axioms receive no conformance judgment.

grounding.quote:
Applicability and conformance
are separate predicates on the named design boundary and governing basis.

constraints.statement: Evaluate every applicable product, graph, language, runtime, handler, and module axiom. Preserve original labels: pass maps to satisfied on the exact evidenced axiom predicate; fail to falsified with counterexample; supported not_applicable falsifies applicability under its owning law without judging conformance; unsupported exclusion leaves applicability indeterminate and required coverage intact. Missing decisive evidence is indeterminate, unusable basis invalid_basis, and applicable work outside bound scope/capability out_of_frame, not excluded. Undertaken interrupted evaluation remains performed with extent/counterexamples; never undertaken is not_performed; uncertain execution unconfirmed. Exclusion results remain coverage evidence and are not conjoined as failed conformance axioms; unresolved applicability leaves coverage unresolved. Minimum columns retain axiom/evaluated predicate, exact subject/basis, Ontology evidence, authority, domain/sequence/state evidence, native enforcement, admission/compiler enforcement, original domain outcome, core verdict, performance/extent, effects, and residual/gap owner. Columns may resolve existing records. Bare pass/fail/not_applicable is an incomplete handoff.

exceptions: Visibility through declared graph/compute algebra is specifically required for graph-native work.

grounding.quote: The cross-view evaluation must prove that:

constraints.statement: Prove every view element derives from accepted Ontology; every discovered functionality row is derived/deferred/excluded/gap; every sequence participant and lifecycle carrier exists in the domain model; every message has a semantic/effect boundary; every lifecycle transition derives from admitted truth; every function/transition has an explicit authority path not implicitly widened by composition; every public operation projects an Ontology function rather than authoring peer semantics; raw probabilistic output cannot directly become accepted/closed; handlers/plugins own interiors only while runtime owns admission, events, continuation, closure; native types enforce locally decidable relations; admission/semantic compilation owns global references, completeness, and realization gaps. For graph-native work, every batch, retry, recursion, or nested workflow is visible through declared graph/compute algebra. A relied-on semantic_not_realized constructor is blocking and cannot be replaced by plugin, shell, service, script, or test-harness imperative glue.
constraints.uncertainty: The external-participant allowance in Sequence model and the universal domain-model participant requirement here are both retained; the supplied text does not explicitly reconcile them.

conditions: Design gate, retrospective review, or unchanged realization_refactor as specified.
exceptions: An unchanged realization_refactor reuses the accepted Ontology/design basis after identifying touched projections and proving no entity, relationship, lifecycle, authority, function, effect, or public-semantic delta; it creates no new Ontology or acceptance ceremony.

grounding.quote:
The design authority separately records its
`accepted` or `non-accepted` decision.

constraints.statement: At the gate, apply Contract application to exact assessment admissibility/support and conjoin required Ontology, design-view, constructability, and axiom results. Acceptance is a separate authority decision requiring satisfied conformance and lawful mandate; non-acceptance retains the actual failed, unresolved, or diagnosed result and does not itself mean falsified. Assess either decision's lawfulness separately, retaining decision/reason. View count, empty sets, or supported exclusions cannot replace required coverage. New/semantically changed boundaries require both Ontology and design acceptance before promotion of implementation/public contract/semantic carrier or closure. Failed applicable axioms, missing functionality dispositions, unresolved authority paths, and blocking realization gaps keep the decision non-accepted. Co-evolution-admissible implementation may precede/accompany evidence and be retained after reconciliation, but before acceptance is provisional, supplies no semantic truth/publication authority/promotion/closure. Otherwise only disposable spikes may cross affected unresolved/contradictory/materially non-equivalent relations before acceptance. Retrospective code may inform design; newly discovered material ambiguity, contradiction, or materially non-equivalent network makes decision_complete(B) false and activates the gate. Compare code to prior authority, never rewrite Ontology/diagrams merely to rationalize unlawful code. Keep assets boundary-bounded; unrelated bootstrap, harness, projection, or delivery shapes added for apparent completeness are defects. Absence of Ontology, any view, cross-view evaluation, or either acceptance decision prevents completion and promotion/publication/closure; provisional continuation additionally requires co_evolution_admissible(B).
constraints.uncertainty: co_evolution_admissible(B), decision_complete(B), and the full constructability contract are not defined in the supplied sections.

conditions: Every material realization component and material semantic boundary.
exceptions: Behavior already within an abstract declared role is ordinary variation; new operational responsibility or new semantic/authoritative role requires design re-entry.

grounding.quote:
Technology capability does not confer
authority.

constraints.statement: Every material component has an explicit semantic/operational role set; several roles are lawful. Role declarations are design authority, and authority-bearing composition/use preserves applicable STDO-UP-004 relations without making that law owner of the role model. Out-of-role use cannot silently establish identity, admission, lifecycle, ordering, closure, or projection truth. At material boundaries, require computational projection and cross-view proof of one system. Under SPEC_METHOD build-tenant binding, machine, human, and mixed processes state operations, composition, effects, authority, resource measures, units, and observation boundaries. Human operations retain input/outcome/refusal/recovery contracts; titles are not implementations. Software mechanics apply only where software realizes the boundary. Material producer-consumer paths identify fact establishment, consumers, basis/invalidators, effect boundaries, retained alternatives, and accumulated work; apply referenced validity/reuse and enclosing-relation admission, including material method/assurance operations. Local success does not establish the whole path, nor do different names establish different responsibilities. Material algorithms declare supported dimensions, workloads/growth, and operational assumptions. Bind Product-owned acceptance limits and owners before qualification; challenge representative supported paths/growth; directly observe work where time cannot locate it without re-executing merely to count; separate startup, framework, external computation, transport, and assurance costs. Existing design/proof surfaces carry these relations; no extra accounting system or fixed complexity is demanded.
constraints.uncertainty: STDO-UP-004, build-tenant binding, workspace validity/reuse, and STDO-UP-021 are external dependencies.

conditions: Computational similarity or material algorithmic obligations in M(B).
exceptions: Independent implementations may be justified by isolation, substrate, performance, security, or dependency ownership without new semantic ownership.

grounding.quote: Computational similarity produces a candidate, never an adjudication:

constraints.statement: Similarity leads to a commonization candidate, then semantic/operational equivalence evaluation, then reuse, parameterized common relation, or justified separation. Shared maps/sequences may differ in identity/key law, ownership, ordering, mutation, consistency/concurrency, retention, failure, access, lifecycle, or truth authority. Materially non-equivalent law requires separation; other differences justify it only if parameterization/adaptation would weaken ownership, authority, lifecycle, failure, or operational constraints. Difference alone does not discharge Prime contraction/recurrence review. Each material algorithmic obligation carries semantic disposition (existing accepted relation, extension, new candidate) and realization disposition (consume, implement locally, optimize, adapt, deliberately duplicate under stated non-semantic constraints). Equivalent code may be rebuilt, but local realization cannot claim existing accepted semantic/authoritative relations as new local truth. The law is false for materially equivalent ADTs/algorithms without semantic disposition, generic blocks becoming semantic authority, commonizing superficial similarity despite different identity/ordering/failure/ownership/lifecycle law, or claiming accepted relations as new local truth.
constraints.uncertainty: M(B) and full Prime contraction law are not defined here.

grounding.quote: This is a theoretical justification, not an extra prerequisite.

constraints.statement: The operational method stands independently of world-model or empirical/metaphysical adoption. The source attributes to WORLD_MODEL_METHOD a candidate Markov object as stable self-bounding identity-bearing cut whose effective blanket separates identity-bearing from context-bearing features. Analogies identify IACS with the smallest identity cut, Promotion Test with independent authority, Boundary Inflation with mistaking fragments for peer objects, and strong typing with preventing fuzzy/reconstructive/controller-owned identity boundaries. These are theoretical justification only: rules remain engineering law where the Markov construct is irrelevant, unavailable, or merely candidate-class, and the analogy does not expand method scope.
constraints.uncertainty: The world-model source and validity of its theoretical construct are not supplied or established.

conditions: The method governs a realization boundary.

constraints.statement: Modules should be classified by recommended roles. The taxonomy supports stable ownership cuts for reviewers, maintainers, and refactoring rather than naming ceremony. Modules bound graph-traversal reasoning under finite context, attention, and time, improving the likelihood of correct traversal without guaranteeing it. Review can inspect ownership, consumption, emissions, and sufficient proof without rereading the system; constrained surfaces expose recurrence and ease later library consolidation.

conditions: New or materially changed realization boundaries; reference-derived variants as specified.
exceptions: Unchanged realization_refactor cites accepted relations and proves no material semantic-boundary delta without recreating evidence.
Co-evolution may run derivation and feedback together only when co_evolution_admissible(B).

grounding.quote:
The first chain is semantic derivation. The second is evidence feedback and
cannot select or accept the affected semantic answer.

constraints.statement: Semantic derivation runs constitutional WHAT/owning requirements → Ontology, IACS, target design, three-view evidence → implementation/module-derived tests → reconciliation/acceptance → promotion/closure. Feedback from implementation/tests supplies evidence, counterexamples, or falsification to affected Ontology/design relations, never semantic selection/acceptance. Design owns structural HOW. Where decision_complete(B) is false, gate the smallest causally closed affected decision set and let retained implementation follow acceptance. Probabilistic/agentic construction uses SPEC_METHOD's Agentic Construction Execution handoff into bounded construction, assessment, disposition, checkpoint, continuation; this method supplies frame/admission/reconstruction/computational/module evidence, not a second execution protocol. Completion requires final implementation traceable to accepted Ontology and design/module assets, tests traceable to module ownership, discoveries reconciled into Ontology/views before promotion/closure, and no hidden controller/authority path compensating for unrealized constructors. Implementation-discovered tests must re-express closure proof against ownership. Minimum chain includes constitutional WHAT, accepted Ontology, target design, module assets/Ontology-derived IACS, accepted domain/sequence/state plus axioms, implementation, and same-Ontology/module-derived tests. With a reference realization, insert reference design and reference-to-target Ontology/design mappings. Jumping directly from design/code to tests without reconstructing module boundaries yields insufficient proof.
constraints.uncertainty: The external Agentic Construction Execution protocol and decision predicates are not supplied.

conditions: Unit proof and module closure under this method.
exceptions: Helper-level tests are allowed but cannot be canonical module proof.
Transitional slice-gating tests may exist but cannot replace module-derived unit proof.

grounding.quote: They must derive from module ownership evidence, not from code shape alone.

grounding.quote:

chance of at least one detection under those conditions, not the probability
that the whole product is correct.

constraints.statement: Select assurance against obligations, consequences, and resources, binding coverage/uncertainty/action/acceptance. Replacing factors by P(M_i|V,Gamma) needs relevant conditional independence. One minus joint miss probability is at-least-one detection, not whole-Product correctness. Samples/injected defects calibrate only their justified relation to operational failures. Unsupported numeric confidence stays unresolved. Risk/assurance policy constrains cost selection even when cheaper plans exist.
constraints.uncertainty: No instantiated probability model, numerical confidence, or acceptance threshold is supplied.
